scope: Connected two-wide integer execution with synthetic instruction/PC supply, real PRF operands, registered computed results, wakeup and in-order retirement. Not a complete processor: no fetch, branch/jump execution, predictor, LSU, memory operations, CSR/trap head controller, multi-producer arbitration, selective producer cancellation, architectural-suite promotion of this top, integrated formal proof or physical timing closure. FPGA is outside project scope; the post-verification clock review and LibreLane GDSII path remain future gates.
